selector.rationale: The patient's history of rheumatoid arthritis treatment and the presence of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, along with the brain biopsy showing thick exudate in the subarachnoid space and lymphocytes and plasma cells, support Rheumatoid Meningitis. Multiple Sclerosis is a close second due to the presence of oligoclonal bands and white matter changes on MRI, but the lack of clear-cut episodes of demyelination and the presence of systemic symptoms point more towards Rheumatoid Meningitis.

rejected.label: CNS Vasculitis
rejected.why: Negative results for vasculitis on brain biopsy and lack of vascular abnormality on MRA

rejected.label: Neurosarcoidosis
rejected.why: Negative special staining for tuberculosis and fungal infection, and lack of granulomatous inflammation on biopsy
